title: AC1024 physical ACDBASSOCVARIABLE output and readback proof

implementation.summary: Added bounded source snapshots and source-to-emitted inspection for all physical AC1024 variables, ancestor networks and dictionaries. Staged bytes are checked for exact known fields, mapped handles, owner/reactor roles, network action membership, dictionary keys, and owned value-dependency children. Finalization rechecks every ancestor identity, owner and reachable handle after inspection. The DXF decoder now exposes network and variable fields to the independent staged scanner.
implementation.failureBehavior: A late variable-field mutation after OBJECTS writing refuses publication and preserves a preexisting destination sentinel. Restoring the source field permits corrected retry on the same adapter; the final output is reparsed and checked. The selector runs these controls for ASCII and binary DXF.
implementation.fixturePolicy: Reused the existing local mechanical DWG witness. The focused selector authors no DWG/DXF fixture files; generated outputs are temporary and removed after readback.

cliOperation.stagedInspector: PASS: 17 source variables matched 17 staged/readback variable records, 2 network records and 2 owning dictionaries in ASCII AC1024 output.

freshReadback.result: PASS for ASCII and binary output. Each mode freshly imports 17 variables, both networks and their two keyed owner dictionaries; compares all variable identity, action, string, EvalVariant, flag and reactor-count fields; verifies 13 suffix-owned value-dependency records under their output variable owners and compares their typed payloads/targets; and closes network action and dictionary-entry roles.

focusedAsan.result: PASS for ASCII and binary output, late-mutation refusal, sentinel preservation and same-adapter retry.

validation.cliReadDisposition: Explicit partial mode was used. It reports 228 opaque callback views and zero retained correlation frames; the strict-complete gate is unchanged.

limitations: The witnessed AC1024 profile does not assign semantic meaning to the retained zero suffix marker.

DXF does not encode the variable body's DWG suffix reference directly; readback proves the corresponding emitted value-dependency child and its owner. The staged source-to-output binding proves the source suffix target identity.
This physical partial-output proof does not close the other callback profiles, strict complete conversion, consumer semantics, platform qualification or any support claim.
